parsed.reason: This is an acute symptom question ("what do I give her") — exactly the one exception where Hale must not coach and must name both numbers: 811 and 911. The reply does precisely that: declines to advise, gives 811 for any-time guidance, and gives 911 for escalation. It does not suggest a remedy, does not guess at a cause, does not send the parent somewhere useless. The 911 trigger condition ("seems to be getting worse or can't keep fluids down") is a reasonable framing that helps the parent calibrate without diagnosing. No greeting, no sign-off, no markdown. This is the correct and complete shape for this message type.
